          <div id="textbook-series" class="article-category">
            <h3 class="category-title">The Geometry of Motion &mdash; Textbook Series</h3>
            <p class="category-intro">A comprehensive textbook covering the mathematical foundations of multibody dynamics, from linear algebra through Lagrangian mechanics to machine learning. <a href="articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto/index.html">View full series →</a></p>

              </button>
              <div class="accordion-content">
                <p>Twelve chapters covering linear algebra, state-space representations, rotation matrices, screw axes, exponential coordinates, recursive algorithms, spatial algebra, product of exponentials, articulated body algorithms, Lagrangian mechanics, and machine learning for dynamics.</p>
                <a href="articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto/volume0.html" class="resource-link">Open Volume 0 →</a>
              </div>

                <span class="accordion-icon">+</span>
              </button>
              <div class="accordion-content">
                <p>Eight chapters developing tangent-space dynamics, variational equations, local optimal control, the stability-optimality duality, coordinate-free Riemannian methods, computational certification, high-dimensional applications, and implementation guidance.</p>

              </div>
